items.title: RGV on Tiger Shroff firing case arrests: 'Capturing shooters is neither...'
items.body: <![CDATA[Filmmaker Ram Gopal Varma expressed views on the arrest of shooters linked to a crime incident. He highlighted that shooters are easily replaceable within criminal networks, emphasizing their low value. Varma compared their roles to construction laborers who execute tasks without strategic input. He argued that the real power lies with those who orchestrate violent operations. As a result, capturing shooters does not dismantle the overarching criminal organization.

With nearly 23 million attendees, audiences are captivated by the gripping tale of a retired jailer battling a perilous idol-smuggling ring while safeguarding his loved ones.

items.title: 'Drishyam 3: The Conclusion' day 22: Ajay's film earns Rs 564.95 cr worldwide
items.body: <![CDATA[On its 22nd day in theaters, Ajay Devgn’s 'Drishyam 3: The Conclusion' saw a dip in box office performance, earning Rs 1.40 cr—a 33.3% decrease from the prior day. Despite this decline, the film has accumulated a robust net total of Rs 363.25 cr domestically and Rs 564.95 cr globally, aided by international viewership. Interestingly, audience turnout improved throughout the day, reflecting ongoing interest in the thriller.

items.title: 'Ranabaali' BO day 8
items.body: <![CDATA[On its eighth day, Ranabaali, starring Vijay Deverakonda and Rashmika Mandanna, saw a significant drop in box office returns, raking in Rs 2.10 crore in India, which equates to a 33.3% fall from the prior day. The film's cumulative domestic net stands at Rs 47.30 crore, and the worldwide earnings have hit Rs 66.45 crore. Friday's occupancy was a modest 30%, gathering approximately 185,175 viewers.

items.title: 'Titans' BO day 2: Jayasurya, Vinayakan film earns Rs 1.00 cr in India
items.body: <![CDATA[Jayasurya's Malayalam fantasy film 'Titans' faced a notable drop in box office earnings on its second day, bringing in just Rs 35 lakhs, a 46.2% decrease compared to its inaugural day. With a two-day net total of Rs 1.00 crore and 11.63% theatre occupancy, the contrasting performance of Mathew Thomas' 'Udumbanchola Vision', which opened at Rs 16 lakhs, reveals shifting audience preferences in cinemas.

items.title: 'Fauzi' teaser OUT: Netizens react to Prabhas' rebel avatar
items.body: <![CDATA[Prabhas recently marked his 47th birthday with a double treat for fans, revealing thrilling updates about his upcoming projects. The first teaser for 'Fauzi' highlights his role as a soldier in the fight against British oppression, set to premiere in March 2027. Meanwhile, 'Kalki 2898 AD 2' celebrated the occasion with a special video featuring Prabhas on set, though its release date remains unannounced.

items.title: Michael Gray passes away at 75
items.body: <![CDATA[On October 16, Michael Gray, celebrated for his iconic roles in 'Shazam!' and 'The Brady Bunch' during the 1970s, quietly departed this life due to natural causes. Born in Chicago, he later transitioned into children's theatre education and pursued interests in men's fashion. Alongside his wife, he co-managed a floral shop in West Hollywood. He is survived by his beloved wife and stepchildren.

items.title: Julia Roberts remembers ‘Steel Magnolias’ co-star Tom Skerritt
items.body: <![CDATA[Julia Roberts honored her late co-star Tom Skerritt, who sadly passed away at the age of 93 on October 16 due to natural causes. Renowned for his memorable role in 'Steel Magnolias,' Skerritt's legacy is celebrated widely, with fellow co-stars like Lauren Holly and Kathy Baker sharing heartfelt tributes. His family fondly remembers his extraordinary humor and passion for storytelling, which touched many lives throughout his career.

items.title: 'Salaar: Part 2 – Shouryaanga Parvam' may begin filming in June 2027

Additionally, a teaser of Prabhas in 'Fauzi' was released, highlighting his role as a soldier fighting British rule.

items.title: Ram Gopal Varma mocks shooters in Tiger Shroff firing case
items.body: <![CDATA[Ram Gopal Varma shared his thoughts on the shooters involved in the incident with Tiger Shroff. He compared them to fictional characters, asserting they would not fit even minor roles in a film. Previously, Varma speculated that the motivation behind this unusual incident might be vanity rather than typical gang-related factors. The firing occurred near a football club, injuring two individuals but leaving Shroff unharmed.

items.body: <![CDATA[In an exciting development, director Mitakshara Kumar is gearing up to launch a new chapter in the 'Tanu Weds Manu' saga. This romantic comedy will showcase a lineup of new characters and a standalone plot, marking a departure from Kangana Ranaut and R. Madhavan's roles. Fans can anticipate the trademark humor that defines the franchise, combined with fresh narratives that promise to charm audiences all over again.

items.title: Maruthi calls Prabhas his ‘guru and inspiration’ on 47th birthday; Gopichand extends wishes
items.body: <![CDATA[Prabhas is currently celebrating his 47th birthday on October 23, receiving warm wishes from notable colleagues. Director Maruthi shared a birthday message, highlighting Prabhas as a great inspiration and human being. The actor also received wishes from T Gopichand, who praised his humility amid immense success. Both shared memories from their past collaborations, including the film 'Varsham'. Prabhas continues to inspire many, showcasing the strength of his character.

items.title: Prabhas’ 47th birthday: ‘Kalki 2898 AD’ team shares BTS video
items.body: <![CDATA[On October 23, Prabhas rang in his 47th birthday with exciting news about his upcoming projects. The team behind 'Kalki 2898 AD' celebrated by sharing exclusive behind-the-scenes footage, marking his special day. Fans also got a sneak peek at a new poster for 'Fauzi', a gripping war drama, ensuring both films target a pan-India audience and are set to hit screens in 2027.

items.title: Evangeline Lilly reveals why she QUIT Hollywood
items.body: <![CDATA[Evangeline Lilly, known for her role in 'Ant-Man And The Wasp', decided to leave her acting career. She expressed a desire to have a more direct impact on people's lives through humanitarian work. Reflecting on her journey, Lilly mentioned she achieved many of her personal goals while in Hollywood. However, she faced challenges when stepping away from the fame and success that accompanied her career.

items.title: Sonu Sood leases Versova commercial property for Rs 3.52 crore
items.body: <![CDATA[Bollywood actor Sonu Sood has entered into a five-year rental agreement for a commercial property in Versova. The agreement is valued at Rs 3.52 crore, with a monthly rent starting at Rs 5 lakh. The monthly rent will increase annually, reaching Rs 6.80 lakh by the end of the term. Additionally, a security deposit of Rs 32 lakh was part of the transaction.

items.title: Grover to lead Junglywood; Actor lands first lead in thriller
items.body: <![CDATA[Shaan R Grover, known for “Saiyaara,” will lead the upcoming Hindi film “Junglywood,” backed by Reliance Entertainment and Moon Side Films. A dark satire on nepotism, it’s directed by Chand Mohammad. Grover also stars in “Tum Mere Ho.” The cast includes Akash R Jagga and Irina Rudakova. The trailer is expected by Halloween.

items.title: The Royals 2: Tanuj Chopra replaces Jasmeet as director
items.body: <![CDATA[Tanuj Chopra, who directed “Delhi Crime” seasons two and three, has replaced Jasmeet K Reen as director of “The Royals” season two. Mitakshara Kumar was never signed on, producers say. Chopra began shooting in Jaisalmer on October 19. Nitya Mehra remains attached. Ishaan Khatter, Zeenat Aman, Sakshi Tanwar and Nora Fatehi return.

items.title: Prabhas turns 47: ‘Salaar’ makers tease reunion with Prashanth Neel for sequel
items.body: <![CDATA[Actor Prabhas recently celebrated his 47th birthday, prompting the makers of 'Salaar' to share a special photograph. The image features Prabhas and director Prashanth Neel, who are set to reunite for 'Salaar 2'. While details about the sequel remain limited, fans are excited for the continuation of Prabhas's character Deva's story. The previous installment of 'Salaar' ended with revelations that changed character dynamics and power structures.

items.title: 'Ramayana' trailer debuts at Times Square, draws applause from fans- WATCH
items.body: <![CDATA[Nitesh Tiwari's upcoming film 'Ramayana' has gained significant attention, with its trailer now playing in Times Square. The film features leading actors such as Ranbir Kapoor, Sai Pallavi, and Yash, among others. Reports suggest that the Hindi version may be longer than the English version due to certain edits. The film is set to release on November 5, 2026, with an IMAX version planned.

items.title: When Prabhas opened up about family’s financial crisis
items.body: <![CDATA[Prabhas, a major figure in Indian cinema, reflects on his childhood shyness and family financial difficulties. He considers the time when his father and uncle left the film industry as pivotal. Despite being initially reluctant about acting, he later pursued it after joining acting classes. His success in the ‘Baahubali’ films marked a significant turning point in his career.

items.title: Tiger Shroff firing incident: Alleged burn marks video goes viral
items.body: <![CDATA[Tiger Shroff’s gunpowder burn marks surfaced in a fan page video after the October 18 firing outside a football ground, and his mother Ayesha verified the clip. Three alleged shooters were arrested, and the Lawrence Bishnoi gang reportedly claimed responsibility. Security around Salman Khan and Akshay Kumar has increased as the probe continues.

items.title: ‘418’: Prashanth Neel-presented Telugu horror thriller Twitter review
items.body: <![CDATA[The Telugu horror thriller '418', under the direction of Kirtan Nadagouda, has sparked a variety of responses since its theatrical release. Viewers commend its gripping sound design and eerie atmosphere, yet many find fault with its screenplay and pacing. Centered around a mysteriously locked hostel room in a medical college, the film serves up plenty of jump scares.

items.title: Rishab Shetty wishes Prabhas on 47th birthday
items.body: <![CDATA[Rishab Shetty shared warm birthday wishes for actor Prabhas, celebrating his unforgettable performances that have captured the hearts of millions. In an exciting development, filmmaker Hanu Raghavapudi unveiled a new poster for Prabhas’s forthcoming film, ‘Fauzi’. Meanwhile, Rishab is busy preparing for his pivotal role in the eagerly awaited mythological epic ‘Jai Hanuman’, which promises significant industry collaborations.

items.title: Balu Varghese faces legal notice over alleged misconduct
items.body: <![CDATA[Balu Varghese is facing a legal notice after a woman accused him of inappropriate behavior at a family birthday party. Allegedly intoxicated, Balu's actions prompted the complainant to seek both a written apology and assurance of non-recurrence. Following her revelation, her husband reached out to ask for Balu's side of the story. Additionally, sources indicate there are several other complaints about Balu's conduct at similar social gatherings.

items.title: 'King': SRK and Deepika to reunite for October 26 song shoot
items.body: <![CDATA[Shah Rukh Khan and Deepika Padukone are gearing up to shoot an extravagant song for their upcoming project 'King'. The grand shooting is set to kick off in Mumbai on October 26, led by the talented choreographer Vaibhavi Merchant. With a star-studded cast including Suhana Khan and Abhishek Bachchan, this collaboration promises to add another chapter to the iconic duo's successful cinematic journey.

items.title: Salman's playful dig at Shahid leaves Kareena in splits
items.body: <![CDATA[Salman Khan teased Shahid Kapoor at the IIFA 2027 press conference in Mumbai on October 22 for touching the stage, joking, “Inhone mere pair nahi choohe, stage ko chooa inhone.” Kareena Kapoor Khan was present. The event is set for January 22-23 in Abu Dhabi. Salman’s next films are “Battle of Galwan” and “Monster.”

items.title: Kayadu Lohar shares BTS pic as ‘Manjanathi’ wraps first schedule
items.body: <![CDATA[Director Mari Selvaraj's upcoming film 'Manjanathi' has finished its initial shooting schedule, and actress Kayadu Lohar shared updates. Through social media, Lohar expressed her transformative experience working with Selvaraj, emphasizing the film's emotional depth. The cast includes Priyanka Mohan and Kathir, with music by legendary composer Ilaiyaraaja. Further story details and the film's release date remain undisclosed at this time.

items.title: ‘Jailer 2’ BO Day 9 [Live]: Rajinikanth starrer nears Rs 400 crore India gross
items.body: <![CDATA[Rajinikanth's latest venture, 'Jailer 2', continues to impress at the box office in its second week, having earned approximately Rs 317.20 crore in its debut week. While weekdays saw a drop in earnings, the film bounced back with Rs 2.02 crore on Day 9. Released in Tamil, Telugu, and Hindi, it features the star power of Mohanlal and Shivarajkumar, catering to a diverse audience.

items.title: Varun and Salman vow focus on films; technicians get due
items.body: <![CDATA[Varun Dhawan said at the IIFA 2027 press conference in Mumbai that award shows should celebrate cinema and give technicians more recognition, noting he is a technician’s son. Salman Khan said things are changing. The awards are set for January 22-23, 2027, in Abu Dhabi, with Varun among the hosts.

items.title: Rukmini Vasanth joins Shree Karthick’s next as Thara
items.body: <![CDATA[Rukmini Vasanth has been announced as the lead in Shree Karthick's upcoming film, where she takes on the role of Thara. The director describes the untitled project as an adventurous and heartwarming journey. A video recently released highlights their discussion about the character. In addition, Rukmini is set to appear in various projects, including one alongside Jr NTR, with more information about the film's release and plot coming soon.

items.title: Karnataka SIR: Teaching on the back burner
items.body: Children in government and aided schools across Karnataka have not seen several of their teachers for months, for most of them have been assigned as Booth Level Officers for the Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls. Students tell Rishita Khanna that what initially seemed like fun with many free hours, is now making them anxious...

items.title: A greying population, a strained care system
items.body: Gaps in geriatric healthcare and support systems leave many older people struggling to access medical care, find reliable caregivers, and cope with mental health concerns and social isolation. These challenges threaten their independence and quality of life, particularly among those from economically weaker backgrounds. With Telangana’s population aged 60 and above projected to grow over the next decade, the shortcomings in healthcare, mental health support and community services need urgent attention, finds K. Shiva Shanker

items.title: When mob takes law into its own hands: another man lynched in Keralam’s Palakkad
items.body: The brutal lynching of an aurally challenged, unidentified man near the Moolathara dam in Keralam’s Palakkad has once again shaken the conscience of society. Abdul Latheef Naha speaks to investigators, psychiatrists and forensic experts to understand how did a homeless man become the target of a group that took it upon itself to punish him and such incidents are recurring.

items.title: How India thwarted Pakistan’s bid to steal crucial defence data
items.body: Officers of the Counter Intelligence Cell of Andhra Pradesh, intrigued by a slew of messaging patterns across various social media platforms, busted a major digital honey-trap racket, including the Indian conduits, whose motive was to leak sensitive defence details, specifically Naval intelligence, to the neighbouring country’s Inter-Services Intelligence, writes Sumit Bhattacharjee

items.title: ‘Game boards’ carved on rocks in Kasaragod hint at age-old yen for leisure
items.body: Six such ‘games,’ resembling the Manjadippala or Kadippala boards, were found carved on rocks, hinting that people engaged in recreational activities thousands of years ago. However, doubts have been raised about their antiquity and purpose. Further studies and scientific dating are required to determine their precise age

items.body: The meeting assumes significance as it comes after the conclusion of the series of programmes organised across the country during the Sangh's centenary year, which ended with the recent Vijayadashami celebrations.

items.title: From Ancient Tombs To Forest Trails: Delhi Heritage Walks Begin October 24
items.body: The first walk will take place at Mehrauli Archaeological Park on October 24 at 4 PM. Heritage experts will take visitors through the park's historic structures, explaining their architecture and lesser-known stories from Delhi's past.

items.title: Iran Caps Dollar Purchases At $1,000 Per Day Amid Sanctions-Hit Economy
items.body: According to Fars news agency, under the latest rules for banks and exchange offices, buyers may purchase up to $10,000 in total, capped at $1,000 per day.

items.title: Diego Maradona Death Trial Verdict Set For December 22
items.body: The verdict in the trial over the 2020 death of Argentine football legend Diego Maradona will be delivered on December 22, the court announced Thursday, after six months of hearings.

items.title: DRDO Employee Dies After Neighbour Punches Him In Face Over "Misbehaviour''
items.body: The incident took place between 7.30 pm and 8 pm on Wednesday, when the man, who stays on the first floor of the building, went to the woman's house on the second floor and allegedly misbehaved with her.

items.title: Glitches In Over 10,000 Voter Entries In UP Seat, 2 Poll Officials Suspended
items.body: According to authorities, a detailed inquiry found that a computer assistant at the Voter Registration Centre entered 13,779 Form-8 applications for changes in voter details between May 31 and August 29, 2026. Of these, 10,470 were approved, and 3,309 were rejected.

items.body: The epicentre of the first earthquake was in Nagqu in northern Tibet, at a depth of around 10 km.

items.body: Critics say the animals suffer, pointing to deadly collapses and dangerous escapes, while advocates point to the jobs they create and the heritage they uphold.

items.body: The suit claims Trump violated the Foreign Emoluments Clause, a provision of the US Constitution that bars presidents from taking payments from foreign governments without the approval of Congress

items.title: "Haven't Seen Dime Of That": Piyush Goyal On $100 Billion Climate Finance
items.body: Piyush Goyal called out developed nations for historically contributing the lion's share of global carbon emissions while reneging on their pledged financial and technological support to developing and vulnerable nations under the Paris Agreement.

items.title: Congress Demands Drought Declaration In Gujarat's Saurashtra, BJP Says "Misleading"
items.body: Congress' Randeep Singh Surjewala demanded that Gujarat officially declare drought-hit areas to facilitate immediate financial compensation packages and relief measures.

items.title: Apple's iPhone Duo Hits Stores In Face Of Short Supply And High Demand
items.body: The iPhone lineup is Apple's largest moneymaker, generating roughly half of the company's revenue. And the Duo is the biggest single design change in the device's nearly two-decade history.

items.title: Thousands March On Paris Streets After Court Lifts Macron's Protest Ban
items.body: French President Emmanuel Macron blamed the weekend's violence on "actions led by radical far-left groups who aimed to bring the Republic down".

items.body: Stock Market, Sensex, Share Market, Nifty LIVE Updates: Brent crude futures fell 0.38% to $112.74 a barrel, while US WTI crude was at $99.15 a barrel.

items.title: 450 Get Anti-Rabies Vaccine After Consuming Milk From Suspected Rabid Cow
items.body: The incident prompted devotees who had consumed the 'charanamrit' during Durga Puja to seek vaccination as a precaution.

items.title: Tom Brady donated $170,000 Salem State speaking fee to charities in 2015
items.body: Tom Brady collected $170,000 for a speaking gig at Salem State University, generously donating the entire sum to charity. He allocated $50,000 to Best Buddies and distributed the remaining funds to various other organizations. With approximately 4,000 attendees present, ticket sales effectively covered his speaking fee. However, the event was notable for Brady facing questions about the NFL's Deflategate saga. The university reported a financial profit from hosting the event.

items.title: 'He put it back': Trump says Ukraine's Starlink restored, stays silent on Musk
items.body: Ukraine depends heavily on Starlink for communications between military units, coordinating operations and receiving early warnings during Russian missile attacks. The satellite-based network also supports the use of drones, which Ukraine deploys both to strike Russian targets and to defend against incoming attacks. Disruptions to connectivity can therefore affect the military's ability to operate drones and respond to Russian assaults.

items.title: Congress defaming India to shield Nehru-Gandhi family: PM Modi
items.body: “Dimagi naxals have captured Congress so much that it has lost its ability to think. Those who used to cause destruction in forests are now determined to wreak havoc on the country through Congress,” PM Modi said, referring to hardcore Left elements accused of being sympathetic to Maoists and now vocal in protests against EC and govt.

items.title: Jason Momoa buys Sam Neill's former 4.92-hectare NZ estate for NZ$15m
items.body: Jason Momoa has recently acquired a significant property in Queenstown, New Zealand for NZ$15 million. The estate, formerly owned by Sir Sam Neill, demonstrates the increasing interest in the local real estate market. Property values in the region have risen significantly, attracting overseas buyers. Momoa has deep connections to New Zealand, having visited frequently for leisure and work. He has also invested in the local film industry and nightlife scene.

items.title: California family spent $4,000 turning its front yard into Jurassic Park
items.body: In Granada Hills, a family has dedicated $4,000 to create an elaborate Jurassic Park-themed display for Halloween. After investing over 200 hours, they've constructed life-sized dinosaur replicas and an automated escape show, complete with grand entrance gates. Open to the public at no cost, this attraction fosters community spirit as neighbors flock to capture the experience and enjoy this festive installation.

items.title: Centre betrayed us, now want full statehood for Ladakh: Sonam Wangchuk
items.body: Wangchuk said the representatives of Leh Apex Body (LAB) and Kargil Democratic Alliance (KDA) had come prepared for Oct 22 talks in Delhi as a follow up of the May 15 meeting in Leh, with the expectation that the MHA and Ladakh bodies' respective drafts on contours and powers of UT-level body and district councils, would be discussed.

items.title: Anahat scripts history, storms into maiden PSA Gold semi-final
items.body: Anahat Singh pulled off an impressive comeback against Salma Hany, clinching her spot in the semi-finals at a PSA Gold-level event after a nail-biting five-game match that lasted 42 minutes. The 18-year-old, facing a 1-2 deficit, demonstrated resilience and skill. Anahat will now go head-to-head with Malaysia's Sivasangari Subramaniam, reigniting their rivalry from the Asian Games final, solidifying her remarkable tournament journey in Redwood City.

items.title: Amid attacks, sales surge at Kolkata Left bookstalls
items.body: Book stalls set up by Left parties saw significant sales increases during Durga Puja amid incidents of vandalism. The CPM stall at Jadavpur 8B bus stand recorded sales of Rs 16 lakh, nearly four times last year's figures. Despite attacks, sales for other Left stalls also increased, evidencing a broader engagement with literature. Politicians from various parties expressed solidarity with the Left stalls amidst ongoing disputes.

items.title: Texas farmer went from 27 sheep to overseeing 10,000 across 40,000 acres
items.body: JR Howard experienced hardships early on with only a small number of sheep, making it tough to earn a living. However, after landing a grazing contract with solar farms, he expanded his flock and income significantly. This eco-friendly grazing method is being embraced by renewable energy companies as a cost-effective way to manage vegetation, while farmers benefit from expansive grazing land without hefty property expenses.

items.title: Eric Schmidt sees China behind the US in the AI race by at least 6 months
items.body: Eric Schmidt highlighted that China is approximately six months behind the US in artificial intelligence capabilities. He noted that Chinese companies offering low-cost or free AI products are gaining traction globally. Schmidt expressed concern that this strategy could facilitate significant market advantages for Chinese firms. Additionally, he discussed how smuggled technology has aided China's rapid advancements.

items.title: Red Corner Notice against Russian ‘who fled with child’
items.body: The Delhi Police have issued a Red Corner Notice for Russian citizen Viktoriia Basu due to alleged violations of child custody regulations. Viktoriia reportedly exited India with her son in defiance of a Supreme Court shared custody ruling. Extradition efforts are currently underway with Russian officials to find her. Furthermore, an associate, Natasha, is being investigated for allegedly facilitating her departure.

James Bond screen tests begin: Richard Madden joins 007 race
items.body: <![CDATA[Casting for the next James Bond is progressing with screen tests scheduled to begin shortly. Richard Madden has emerged as an unexpected candidate alongside several other actors competing for the role. Reports indicate that initial screen tests are slated for Friday under the direction of Denis Villeneuve. While comprehensive assessments will be conducted, details about the testing process remain unclear.

items.title: 'Jailer 2' BO day 8: Rajinikanth’s film earns Rs 606.05 cr worldwide
items.body: <![CDATA[In just eight days since its debut, Rajinikanth's 'Jailer 2' has garnered impressive gross collections of Rs 606.05 crore globally. The film has seen robust contributions from both regional and international theaters; however, on October 22, India's net earnings dipped to Rs 17.15 crore. Tamil screenings dominated, making up over 62% of daily revenues.

items.title: 'Ranabaali' BO day 7: Vijay Deverakonda film reaches Rs 63.65 cr
items.body: <![CDATA[Ranabaali, featuring Vijay Deverakonda and Rashmika Mandanna, earned Rs 63.65 cr in its first week. The film faced a decline in net collections, dropping to Rs 3.15 cr on the seventh day. It had a total of 2,112 shows with a 31% occupancy rate on Thursday. The film's overall earnings included Rs 52.55 cr from India and Rs 11.10 cr from overseas.

items.title: 'Titans' BO day 1: Jayasurya’s film opens with Rs 75 lakhs gross
items.body: <![CDATA[The Malayalam comedy fantasy thriller 'Titans' premiered in cinemas on October 22, 2026, grossing an impressive Rs 65 lakhs on its opening day. With total earnings reaching Rs 75 lakhs and an occupancy rate of 23%, the film’s success was largely driven by Kerala, contributing Rs 70 lakhs to the total.

items.title: 'Nayyi Navelli' box office collection day 7: Yami Gautam’s film earns Rs 29.06 cr worldwide
items.body: <![CDATA[Yami Gautam's latest release 'Nayyi Navelli' has made a splash, amassing Rs 29.06 crores in its opening week globally. Domestically, it enjoyed Rs 22.15 crores, though ticket sales dipped on Thursday. The total footfall reached 1,098,344, showcasing the film's popularity, particularly on the seventh day with 87,366 attendees. With an opening collection of Rs 3.

items.title: 'Drishyam 3: The Conclusion' day 21: Ajay's film crosses Rs 563 cr worldwide
items.body: <![CDATA[As of October 22, Ajay Devgn's 'Drishyam 3: The Conclusion' boasts remarkable global earnings of Rs 563.02 crore, with an Indian net collection of Rs 361.85 crore. Despite a noticeable drop in audience attendance in the days following its release, the film has managed to achieve substantial box office success. The overall financial outcome still reflects strong viewer engagement and appeal.

items.title: 'Prahaar: The Ujjwal Nikam Story' day 7: Rajkummar’s film mints Rs 22.94 cr worldwide
items.body: <![CDATA[Prahaar: The Ujjwal Nikam Story collected Rs 22.94 crore in worldwide gross earnings after its first week. The film earned Rs 1.20 crore in India on its seventh day of theatrical release. Its domestic net total reached Rs 17.15 crore by the end of the week. The movie's earnings saw a decrease compared to earlier days within the first week.

items.title: Tamil Nadu CM Vijay mourns Krishnaraj
items.body: <![CDATA[Tamil Nadu Chief Minister Joseph Vijay expressed his condolences following the passing of veteran playback singer Krishnaraj. The singer, known for his vibrant voice, made significant contributions to Tamil cinema throughout his career. Krishnaraj's collaborations with renowned composers left a lasting impact on Tamil film music and earned him several accolades. His death comes shortly after the passing of another prominent figure in the industry, Deva.

items.title: ‘Harry Potter’ joins 'Game Of Thrones' as one of most expensive series
items.body: <![CDATA[HBO's upcoming adaptation of 'Harry Potter' is reported to have an estimated budget of USD 201 million. The series will rank among the most expensive productions ever, increased by new financial filings. Production company Plum Jam Productions shows significant revenue growth as work on the first season begins. Each of the eight episodes could cost about GBP 18.8 million while HBO commits to more seasons.

items.title: HBD Prabhas: Must-watch films of the 'Spirit' actor
items.body: <![CDATA[On October 23, Prabhas celebrated his 47th birthday, garnished with grand festivities worldwide. Fans flocked outside his home in Hyderabad, applauding and waving colorful posters and flags. The joyful occasion included reliving iconic films like 'Varsham', 'Mirchi', and 'Baahubali: The Epic' available on streaming platforms, showcasing Prabhas's enduring legacy in Telugu cinema.

items.title: Prabhas turns 47 as Japanese fans share birthday video
items.body: <![CDATA[On his 47th birthday, Prabhas is showered with love from fans across the globe. A touching birthday video from his Japanese admirers highlighted the impact of his films. Meanwhile, a throng of supporters gathered outside his Hyderabad home, waving posters and cheering passionately. The celebrations leading up to his special day further underscore his massive following. With several exciting projects ahead, fans eagerly anticipate what’s next for their beloved star.

items.title: Smita Jayakar recalls trying to help Sushant Singh Rajput
items.body: <![CDATA[Smita Jayakar recounted her visit to Sushant Singh Rajput at Hinduja Hospital in Mumbai, prompted by Rhea Chakraborty's appeal for help due to Sushant's struggles with depression. During their encounter, Sushant expressed openness to the idea of healing at Smita's ashram. Following Sushant's passing, Smita mulled over the chances missed to offer him more support and extended her compassion towards Rhea for her attempts to assist Sushant during tough moments.

items.title: Aamir Khan gets emotional at Singapore Film Festival
items.body: <![CDATA[At the Singapore International Film Festival, Aamir Khan shared his heartfelt experiences, emphasizing the sacrifices made by his family over the years. He candidly discussed the repercussions of the COVID-19 pandemic on his relationships and confirmed that a sequel to '3 Idiots' is in the works by director Rajkumar Hirani.

items.title: ‘Ramayana’ advance booking Day 1 headed for Rs 10 crore mark
items.body: <![CDATA[‘Ramayana: Rise of a Legend’ has recorded advance ticket sales of Rs 8.16 crore for its opening day. The film's release is scheduled for November 5, 2026, and it features prominent actors. Major cities contributing to advance sales include Delhi, Mumbai, and Bengaluru. Hindi screenings dominate the sales, with premium formats also proving popular among audiences. The film will be available in several languages, including Hindi, Tamil, and English.

items.title: CBFC says Sunny Deol's 'Suryaa' has not been submitted for certification

items.title: Judi Dench says she can no longer act or read as eyesight deteriorates

Diagnosed with age-related macular degeneration in 2012, Dench continues to face daily challenges.

Skerritt won an Emmy for his performance in 'Picket Fences' and was nominated twice. He appeared in notable films like 'Top Gun', 'Steel Magnolias', and 'Alien'. His contributions to storytelling and creativity will be fondly remembered by many.

items.title: 'Vidhan Sabha uda diya': Bengaluru police arrest Bihar man over AI video
items.body: Bengaluru City Police have arrested a 25-year-old migrant worker for posting an alarming AI-generated video online. The video depicted a bomb blast at Vidhana Soudha, the Karnataka government's seat. The suspect, Hazrat Ali Shoiab, had been working as a daily-wage pipefitter in the city. Police discovered the footage during routine digital surveillance and tracked down the suspect's account. Investigations are ongoing to understand Shoiab's motives and identify any collaborators.

items.title: Delhi-NCR pollution: How GRAP Stage 1 curbs can protect your heart and lungs
items.body: Delhi-NCR has launched GRAP Stage 1 to combat the rising air pollution levels and protect health standards. The initiative focuses on controlling dust, limiting specific fuel types, and tightening regulatory enforcement. Health experts stress the importance of immediate intervention to guard vulnerable populations against the health implications of poor air quality. Citizens are urged to adopt personal safety measures during smoggy days.

items.title: Georgia woman loses marijuana smoke case as court upholds pension fund immunity
items.body: A Georgia woman sued after claiming her neighbour’s marijuana smoke repeatedly entered her apartment despite a no-smoking lease, affecting her breathing and health. Bridget Francis alleged that the apartment management ignored her complaints. However, on October 19, 2026, a Georgia appeals court upheld the dismissal of her claims against a California teachers’ pension fund, ruling that it was legally protected from the lawsuit.

items.title: China's restored reefs hold 286 oysters per sq m; particles down 62%
items.body: A study of oyster reef restoration in China's Bohai Bay has found encouraging signs of marine habitat recovery between 2022 and 2026. By March 2026, artificial reefs supported an average of 286 oysters per square metre, while suspended particles in the water had declined by approximately 62%. Published in Frontiers in Marine Science, the study also recorded an increase in seabed animals. However, researchers said further monitoring was needed to establish the project's long-term effectiveness.

items.title: Pala-era Vishnu sculpture sold for Rs 8.16 crore, over 9 times estimate
items.body: A blackstone sculpture of Vishnu, dating to the 11th or 12th century, sold for £635,000 at Christie’s auction. The sculpture was previously part of a Swiss collection and first sold in March 1973. Over the years, the artwork maintained its significance and desirability among collectors. In June 2026, it was auctioned again as part of a collection focusing on South Asian art.

items.title: Exhibition row: Raihan recounts how events unfolded before photos were taken down
items.body: Raihan Vadra's photography exhibition, No Idea Is Fine, allegedly faced turmoil at Bikaner House when management objected hours before its start, claiming venue policy violations. While Vadra proposed removing select images, the officials demanded the removal of all 70 photographs, including those depicting the Indian national flag. This sparked outrage among Congress members, igniting debates about censorship and the value of artistic freedom.

items.title: 'Beacon of hope': Polish PM Tusk hails ties with India, calls PM Modi a 'friend'
items.body: Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk visited India to strengthen bilateral cooperation between India and Poland. He highlighted the absence of conflicts of interest and shared values between the two nations. Both leaders discussed expanding economic opportunities through the India-European Union Free Trade Agreement. Tusk emphasized the positive economic developments achieved by Poland and India over the last 35 years.

items.title: Viral fever, vomiting: How Praveen Kumar fought back to win Asian Para Games gold
items.body: Praveen Kumar won the men’s high jump T44/64 gold medal at the Asian Para Games in Japan. He accomplished this while dealing with a hip injury and battling fever, cold, and cough. Despite these challenges, he cleared 2.05m, setting a new Games record. His previous record was 1.95m in the T44 category. Praveen aims to defend his Paralympic title at the next Los Angeles Games.

items.title: Texas man, 86, spends 39 years building 62-foot boat; strangers step in
items.body: An 86-year-old man from Mineral Wells, Texas, has been building a 62-foot steel boat since 1987. After three visitors discovered his ambition, they launched a crowdfunding campaign to support the project. More than $41,000 has been raised towards completing the boat and moving it to a launch site. The remaining work on the vessel is expected to require about $50,000 in funding.

items.title: PHP2Shell: Govts on high alert over critical website flaw; what users should know
items.body: PHP2Shell, a critical AI-discovered flaw in PHP, the software behind most websites, has forced governments, Wikipedia, hospitals and universities to take sites offline. The decade-old PHP vulnerability lets hackers take over web servers without a password, with millions of attacks logged within hours. Here's what PHP2Shell is, how it works, who is at risk, and what users and website owners should do right now.

items.title: Virginia teen's model improves simulated earthquake sensor coverage by 16.7%
items.body: A 14-year-old student from Williamsburg, Virginia, has become one of 30 finalists in a national science competition after developing a mathematical model to improve earthquake sensor placement. Isabel Rossi's six-month research project showed that adding just five sensors could increase simulated detection coverage by 16.7%. She used earthquake records from California and mathematical methods to identify better sensor locations.

items.title: US soldier killed at 17 in Korean War identified after 75 years, to be buried
items.body: Pvt. Joseph E. Boyd, who went missing in action at just 17 during the Korean War, has finally been identified decades later. His remains, previously known as Unknown X-1642, have been matched to his identity through advanced forensic techniques, including DNA testing. A dignified burial ceremony is set for October 21, 2026, in Owings Mills, Maryland, underscoring the ongoing commitment to honor missing service members from historical conflicts.

Meta Q3 results: Net income jumps 264% to $9.86 bn, but legal charge limit profits
items.body: Meta Platforms reported a net income of $9.86 billion in Q3 2026, tripling from the previous year. Overall revenue increased to $64.60 billion, primarily driven by higher advertising earnings. However, operating income declined due to a significant legal charge linked to teen mental health litigation. The company plans to invest heavily in artificial intelligence infrastructure to support future revenue growth.

items.title: Facial laser session leaves woman with burns; consumer panel orders Rs 1.11 lakh payout
items.body: In an alarming incident at Berkowits Hair & Skin Clinic in Bengaluru, a woman suffered severe second-degree burns during a laser hair removal treatment. Despite her intense pain, the technician minimized her discomfort, labeling it as normal. Subsequent medical examinations validated her injuries. The district consumer commission held the clinic accountable for inadequate service and mandated compensation, including a refund and damages for her injuries and emotional distress.

items.title: After renaming Lake Ontario, Google CEO rejects US request to rename Atlantic Ocean
items.body: President Trump has recently proposed renaming the Atlantic Ocean, following prior discussions about the Atlantic Ocean. During a recent event, he mentioned contacting Google Maps regarding these renaming efforts. Google CEO Sundar Pichai reportedly declined his proposal on the grounds that oceans encompass multiple countries. This follows the US administration's earlier renaming of Lake Ontario to Lake America for US users.

items.body: <![CDATA[DC Studios is set to release its first horror film titled 'Clayface' in theaters on October 23. Early viewers have praised the film for its body-horror sequences and Tom Rhys Harries' performance. However, some criticism has been directed toward the film's third act and tonal inconsistencies. 'Clayface' tells the tragic story of Matt Hagen, highlighting his transformation and descent into vengeance.

items.title: Amitabh Bachchan reveals how he manages household chores
items.body: <![CDATA[Amitabh Bachchan revealed his approach to household chores when domestic help is absent, handling cleaning himself while relying on Jaya Bachchan for cooking. He mentioned his preference for ordering food, noting that Jaya enjoys preparing dishes upon his request. Additionally, he shared how he keeps his family informed about late returns from film shoots through group messages.

items.title: Vishwak Sen takes charge of ‘Cult’ after ‘Laila’ failure
items.body: <![CDATA[Vishwak Sen boldly steps into the director's chair with his new film 'Cult' following a series of setbacks. Taking full ownership of the project, he aims to create a unique cinematic experience featuring a remarkable ensemble of about 150 actors. The film, which also includes renowned talents like Gayatri Bharadwaj and Tarak Ponnappa, will be released in both Japanese and Spanish, hitting theatres on October 30, 2026.

items.title: 'Dragon' actor Khushbu Sundar speaks out against cyberattacks
items.body: <![CDATA[Khushbu has publicly denounced the cyberattacks and personal harassment aimed at celebrities, firmly stating that their status doesn't excuse harassment towards them or their families. After her X account was compromised, she urged her followers to stay alert for any unusual activity and to report it. Meanwhile, she is gearing up for her upcoming role in the film Dragon, featuring Jr NTR.

items.title: Nani credits Telugu audiences for cinema’s global growth: ‘They let us dream big’
items.body: <![CDATA[Nani underscored how Telugu cinema is broadening its global horizons, crediting audiences for their pivotal role in supporting innovative filmmakers. He noted a shifting perception that Telugu films are merely commercial, as an influx of varied narratives comes to light. Nani shared his experiences as an outsider in the industry, highlighting the value of authentic passion over the pursuit of fame or riches.

items.title: Tiger's shooters also targeting Ranbir? Alia REACTS
items.body: <![CDATA[Alia Bhatt has acknowledged the rumors surrounding threats made against her husband, Ranbir Kapoor. She liked a fan post defending Ranbir for attending an event despite a previous shooting incident. The post criticized those who trolled him for a verbal slip during his speech at a Dussehra celebration. Ranbir later apologized for his slip of the tongue at this event.

items.title: Poonam Dhillon addresses Upasana Singh's Nagma’s Rs 90 lakh FD fraud allegations
items.body: <![CDATA[In response to allegations regarding financial oversight at CINTAA, Poonam Dhillon assures that all financial records are maintained with total transparency for committee members. Upasana Singh's earlier concerns about potential financial misconduct and Nagma's worries about allocations for artist salaries illuminate persistent management discord within CINTAA and its executive team.

items.title: Rashmika Mandanna on accent trolling: ‘I am from the South'
items.body: <![CDATA[Rashmika Mandanna has shared her experiences with online trolling concerning her accent and language skills. She emphasized her desire to work across multiple film industries without self-imposed limitations. Mandanna also expressed satisfaction in portraying diverse characters in films like 'Animal' and 'The Girlfriend.' Addressing criticisms of her Hindi dialogue delivery, she stated her South Indian accent is a natural aspect of her identity.

items.title: INSIDE Soubin Shahir’s Kochi apartment
items.body: <![CDATA[Soubin Shahir's apartment in Kochi showcases a significant integration of plants and nature-inspired design throughout. Childhood memories of gardening instilled in him a deep appreciation for nature, which shapes his home. The apartment features landscaped balconies and various plant species that create a tranquil atmosphere. He personally maintains the greenery, ensuring that it flourishes in the urban environment.

items.title: ‘I am not comfortable': Rashmika Mandanna, Vijay Deverakonda on Janhvi's Peddi row
items.body: <![CDATA[Rashmika Mandanna has addressed the debate around Janhvi Kapoor’s portrayal in 'Peddi' on 'Koffee With Karan' Season 9. The actress said she is uncomfortable with excessive skin show and draws personal boundaries around costumes. Vijay Deverakonda added that actors need support to refuse scenes without being labelled unprofessional. The episode aired on October 21, days after their film Ranabaali released in theatres. Sacnilk estimated its worldwide gross at Rs 52.40 crore as of October 21, amid mixed reviews.

items.title: Frankel’s Profitable Home Flip: TV star transforms dated colonial; nets $1.2 million gross gain
items.body: <![CDATA[In 2020, Bethenny Frankel purchased a charming colonial home in Greenwich, Connecticut, for roughly $2.1 million. After undertaking several thoughtful renovations, she put the house on the market, and it quickly found a new buyer for about $3.3 million. This impressive sale resulted in a gross profit of $1.2 million, showcasing Frankel's keen eye for properties that blend potential updates with historic allure.

items.title: Levine’s Beverly Crest Flip: Adam Levine turns ranch into luxury retreat; John Mayer buys in 2018
items.body: <![CDATA[Adam Levine bought a ranch-style home in Beverly Hills for nearly five million dollars in October 2012. After six years, he sold the renovated property to John Mayer for approximately thirteen million dollars. The home underwent significant updates, creating a modern retreat that appealed to buyers. While renovations increased the value, Levine’s profit remains undisclosed after considering renovation and selling costs.

items.title: Nani says he chooses films by instinct, not box office results
items.body: <![CDATA[Actor Nani explained his instinctive approach to selecting films, avoiding focus on box office results. He emphasized the importance of passion over experience when collaborating with debutant directors. Nani expressed interest in acting in a full-length Malayalam film and a Hindi film that requires self-dubbing. He shared a childhood dream of being part of a film like ‘Gladiator’. Currently, he enjoys acting and is not actively pursuing directing projects.

items.title: Pooja Hegde serves timeless ethnic elegance in 1.91 lakh gold tissue silk saree
items.body: <![CDATA[Pooja Hegde showcases understated ethnic glamour in a beige gold tissue silk saree worth Rs 1.91 lakh. Paired with a net blouse, the ensemble is complemented by traditional juttis, subtly lined eyes, nude pink lips, mildly blushed cheeks and soft waves in her short hair. Styled by Garima Garg, the look offers inspiration for wedding ceremonies and festive occasions. On the work front, the actor has appeared in 'Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai' and 'Jana Nayagan'.

items.title: Karan Johar wants a partner to co-parent twins Yash and Roohi, says marriage may not be possible
items.body: <![CDATA[Karan Johar has opened up about wanting love and companionship, revealing that marriage may not be a possibility for him. During a conversation with Vijay Deverakonda on Koffee With Karan 9, the filmmaker said he hopes to find a partner who can share his everyday moments, celebrate his milestones and be an equal parent to his ten-year-old twins, Yash and Roohi. Vijay responded warmly, praying for Karan’s wish to come true as the filmmaker shared his hopes.

items.title: DSP’s acting debut ‘Yellamma’ to release in theatres on March 5, 2027
items.body: <![CDATA[Renowned music composer Devi Sri Prasad is set to step into the acting world with his debut performance in the eagerly anticipated film Yellamma, scheduled for a theatrical release on March 5, 2027. Directed by Venu Yeldandi, this film will be available in five languages, showcasing Devi in the role of Parshi.

items.title: ‘Jailer 2’ BO Day 8 [Live]: Rajinikanth’s film inches closer to Rs 320 crore
items.body: <![CDATA[Rajinikanth's highly anticipated film Jailer 2 showcases impressive box office numbers after a strong debut week. It has gained remarkable traction in Tamil, Telugu, and Hindi markets, with earnings exceeding Rs. 320 crore net in just the first eight days. The film's captivating appeal across diverse audiences ensures it stays in the spotlight, and its box office trend will be watched intently in the days to come.

items.title: Samantha shares childhood photo, inspiring note on self-worth
items.body: <![CDATA[Samantha Ruth Prabhu recently took to Instagram to share an inspiring message about her journey towards self-worth and resilience. Celebrating her perfume brand's impressive revenue of over Rs 120 crore, she reflected on her personal growth and the importance of trusting her skills. With pride in her achievements, she hinted that her most significant chapter is still ahead.

items.title: 'Drishyam 3' BO Day 21 [LIVE]: Eyes Rs 365 crore India net on third Thursday
items.body: <![CDATA[Drishyam 3: The Conclusion has completed three weeks in theatres with another milestone on the board. Ajay Devgn's thriller collected Rs 2.65 crore net on Day 20, a Wednesday, which took its India net to Rs 359.75 crore and the India gross to Rs 431.02 crore. With Rs 129 crore from overseas, the worldwide gross stands at Rs 560.02 crore. The film is now approaching the Rs 400 crore domestic net milestone.

items.title: Tamil playback singer Krishnaraj passes away at 74
items.body: <![CDATA[Krishnaraj, the beloved Tamil playback singer, has sadly passed away at the age of 74 after battling health complications. Renowned for his remarkable vocal talent, he lent his voice to over 3,000 songs, collaborating extensively with composer Deva. Notably, his performance in 'Thanjavooru Mannu Eduthu' earned him the prestigious State Film Award for Best Male Playback Singer.

items.title: Asian Para Games: Swati Chaudhary bags silver in women's W1 archery
items.body: Swati Chaudhary achieved a silver medal in the women's W1 individual archery event at the Asian Para Games. She initially took a 4-2 lead but eventually lost the final to Cen Mengkan of China. After winning the first and third sets, Swati struggled in the fourth and fifth sets, allowing Cen to clinch the gold. This tournament adds to Swati's recent bronze medal win at the World Archery Para Series.

items.title: Brent crude tops $110 as fresh attacks in Saudi raise concerns over oil supplies

The US took precautionary measures by evacuating diplomats' families from the kingdom amid escalating security issues. Simultaneously, US crude inventories dropped sharply, while distillate stocks showed an unexpected increase. items.title: Patrick Mahomes faces tough Chiefs reality as Brittany Mahomes draws attention
items.body: Patrick Mahomes and the Kansas City Chiefs have opened the 2026 NFL season with a perfect 5-0 record after a disappointing 2025 campaign. However, tougher opponents, including the Seattle Seahawks and Denver Broncos, could test their momentum. As the schedule intensifies, Mahomes faces growing pressure to maintain his form. Brittany Mahomes may notice a change in the atmosphere at home if the Chiefs struggle during their demanding stretch of games.

items.title: Tom Brady and Gisele Bündchen's $640K charity donations spark scrutiny
items.body: A 2022 report revealed that Tom Brady and Gisele Bündchen’s Luz Foundation donated $640,402 to various organisations between 2007 and 2019, raising questions about its charitable giving compared with their substantial fortune. The foundation supported environmental, meditation and wellness causes. Separately, Brady’s TB12 Foundation faced scrutiny after reports said it paid his for-profit company more than $1.6 million. The couple also donated 750,000 meals to Feeding Tampa Bay in 2020.

items.title: One killed, 8 injured in Saudi airport attack amid US order for diplomats to leave
items.body: The United States ordered some of its diplomats and the family members of US government employees to leave Saudi Arabia late on Wednesday. The move followed a series of deadly attacks attributed to Yemen's Iran-backed Houthi rebels and growing concerns that the conflict could escalate further. The latest violence has raised concerns about the security of Saudi Arabia's critical infrastructure.

items.title: ‘Badr MoU’ won’t put New Delhi-Jakarta missile contracts in jeopardy, experts say
items.body: Will 'Badr MoU' put India’s recent defence agreements with Indonesia on advanced weaponry in jeopardy? Talking to TOI, Sudhir Kumar Mishra, DRDO chair (emeritus) and former director general, CEO & MD of BrahMos Aerospace, said, “Defence agreements with Indonesia have been done with enough safeguards and that only user manual, not technology of transfer manual, will be shared with Jakarta.”

items.title: Engineer-turned-artist sets Guinness record with chilli-turmeric painting
items.body: Amar Kale, a self-taught artist from Karnataka, created a world record for the largest spice painting. He used approximately 6 kg of turmeric and 5 kg of chilli powder for this artwork. The piece measures 175.82 square metres and tells a story of Karnataka's heritage. His work features the Hampi Chariot and reflects the state's cultural legacy. This achievement followed his earlier record for painted handprints within one minute.

items.title: Missouri court overturns ruling giving couple ownership of neighbour's road
items.body: In a notable case from Missouri, a couple gained legal rights to their isolated property via their neighbor's land. Although the court initially granted them ownership of the access road, it later corrected this decision. Ultimately, they received a permanent easement, illustrating the difference between property rights and ownership. The couple can access their property while the neighbor retains the land under the road.

items.title: Florida owners sue over $13,157 roof fee; allege $232,000 paid before vote
items.body: Homeowners in The Vistas at Phillips Commons have initiated a lawsuit against their homeowners association. They allege that a roofing contract worth $2.1 million was approved secretly before an official vote. The residents claim that a significant deposit was made before the meeting took place, indicating potential financial misconduct. An active criminal investigation is examining alleged irregularities involving both the association and the management company.

items.title: Who is Suvarna Raj? Asian Para Games gold medallist who is also an advocate
items.body: Suvarna Raj, a 44-year-old para-athlete from Greater Noida, won gold for India in the women's F54 discus throw at the Asian Para Games on Thursday. She finished first with a best throw of 15.66m, adding another medal to her international career.

items.title: French riots and Indian protests linked in same ecosystem: Report
items.body: Senior editor Asra Nomani’s investigation says it has identified 101 organisations across nine countries in a “red-green protest ecosystem” (referring to Islamist and communist groups) that are coordinating, organising or amplifying protests in Europe in an expanding protest ecosystem. Her story also flags how transnational anti-capitalist organisation Progressive International (PI) explicitly grouped the current protests in France, Spain, India and Albania.

items.title: Historic win! India's Anahat stuns 8-time World Champion Nour ElSherbini
items.body: Eighteen-year-old Anahat Singh stunned eight-time world champion Nour ElSherbini 11-8, 11-8, 11-7 in 30 minutes at the Silicon Valley Open on Wednesday. The Indian advanced to the quarter-finals of the USD 143,500 PSA Gold event. Earlier, Singh defeated Nour Aboulmakarim in the opening round. The victory marked the biggest win of her professional career, strengthening her reputation as a rising squash star.

items.title: ‘Racial attack’ by Delhi influencer on tribal youth roils Tripura
items.body: In Tripura, a controversial video featuring influencer Amir Shokeen allegedly mocking a tribal youth has ignited political backlash. Leaders throughout the region voiced their outrage, labeling the incident a racial attack and pushing for swift action. CM Manik Saha has directed the Tripura DGP to collaborate with Delhi Police for a comprehensive investigation.

items.title: Kuwait-flagged tanker carrying 21 Indian seafarers hit by projectile in Hormuz
items.body: A Kuwait-flagged oil product tanker, M/T Al Dasma, was struck by an unidentified projectile in the Strait of Hormuz. All 21 Indian seafarers aboard the vessel were reported safe after the incident on October 21. This event follows previous attacks on vessels in the region, raising safety concerns for Indian mariners. The Indian government is in contact with ship management to ensure ongoing security measures.

items.title: Tom Cruise to be honored with American Film Institute award
items.body: <![CDATA[Actor Tom Cruise is set to receive the American Film Institute's Life Achievement Award in April. This award has been given annually since 1973 to individuals who have made significant contributions to film. Previous recipients include notable figures like Bette Davis and Tom Hanks, among others. Cruise has been recognized for his commitment to cinema and his belief in its unifying power.

items.title: 'Ramayana' to make digital debut with pay-per-view streaming option
items.body: <![CDATA[Ramayana: Rise of a Legend is set to be released in cinemas on November 5, 2026. After the theatrical run, it will be available on JioHotstar through a pay-per-view model. This decision aims to make the epic accessible to audiences across India. The film features prominent actors such as Ranbir Kapoor, Sai Pallavi, and Yash. Music composed by A.R. Rahman and Hans Zimmer has also generated significant anticipation.

items.title: 'Drishyam 3: The Conclusion' day 20: Ajay's film earns Rs 560.02 cr worldwide
items.body: <![CDATA[Drishyam 3: The Conclusion saw a decline in box office earnings, collecting Rs 2.65 crore on day twenty. The film's global gross collection reached Rs 560.02 crore, even after the significant dip. Domestically, it has earned Rs 359.75 crore with an overall healthy performance since its release. The film stars Ajay Devgn, Tabu, and others, continuing the suspenseful story from previous installments.

items.title: 'Jailer 2' BO day 7: Rajinikanth film earns Rs 582.45 cr worldwide
items.body: <![CDATA[In its seventh week, Jailer 2, featuring the iconic Rajinikanth and Mohanlal, experienced a slight dip in box office earnings. The film secured Rs 28.15 crore net in India, accumulating an impressive domestic total of over Rs 300 crore. Notably, the Tamil version highlighted the charts with an earning of Rs 18.50 crore on Wednesday, while its global gross exceeded Rs 582.45 crore.

items.title: 'Ranabaali' BO day 6: Vijay Deverakonda film earns Rs 59.65 cr
items.body: <![CDATA[The film Ranabaali, with stars Vijay Deverakonda and Rashmika Mandanna, achieved a remarkable Rs 59.65 crore in total earnings worldwide. On its sixth day, it garnered Rs 5.50 crore, reflecting a decline from Rs 7.10 crore previously. Released on October 16, the film recorded 453,848 total footfalls, maintaining an average occupancy of 40.44% for the Telugu version.

items.title: Govinda offers prayers at Puri Jagannath Temple - WATCH
items.body: <![CDATA[Govinda visited the Shree Jagannath Temple in Puri and offered prayers during the Vijayadashami festival. His visit attracted a large number of fans who cheered for him as he arrived. The actor expressed gratitude for the opportunity and prayed for his children’s well-being. Shree Jagannath Temple is an important Hindu pilgrimage site known for its annual Ratha Yatra.

items.title: Daler Mehndi controversy: FWICE writes to PM Modi
items.body: <![CDATA[The Federation of Western India Cine Employees has expressed support for singer Daler Mehndi amid controversy. FWICE highlighted the importance of sensitivity regarding performers' health after a public incident. The letter addressed to the Prime Minister and Uttarakhand Chief Minister emphasized the contributions of artists to the culture. They called for greater compassion in dealing with performers' issues.

items.title: 'Hanuman Ansh' day 77: Vishal's film earns Rs 451 cr worldwide
items.body: <![CDATA[Hanuman Ansh, released on August 7, 2026, achieved a worldwide gross collection of Rs 451 cr. Its domestic net earnings reached Rs 341.04 cr, while overseas markets contributed Rs 48.60 cr. The film's collections during its 11th week showed a noticeable decline, with daily earnings fluctuating significantly. Directed by Vishal Chaturvedi, the movie highlights the life of Neem Karoli Baba.

items.title: Tiger Shroff firing case: Four accused brought to Anti-Extortion Cell - WATCH
items.body: <![CDATA[Four individuals have been arrested in the shooting incident involving actor Tiger Shroff in Juhu. This incident occurred when Shroff was leaving a football club on Sunday evening. Police have also arrested seven more individuals from Haryana, bringing the total to ten suspects. items.title: 'Crazy Kalyanam' BO day 4
items.body: <![CDATA[Despite initial buzz, Crazy Kalyanam, a family-centric Telugu romantic comedy, saw a decline in box office revenue, earning merely Rs 15 lakhs on October 19, marking a stark fall from the day before. After four days, it accumulated a total of Rs 74 lakhs. Directed by Badrappa Gajula, the narrative highlights the struggles of young Keerthi, portrayed by Anupama Parameswaran, as her aspirations clash with her father's conservative expectations.

items.title: 'Padayaatra' release date announced
items.body: <![CDATA[Mammootty and filmmaker Adoor Gopalakrishnan are collaborating again for the movie 'Padayaatra'. The film's theatrical release is planned for December 4, 2026, following a 32-year hiatus. Its premise revolves around a doctor striving to live ethically both professionally and personally. The cast also includes Indrans, Grace Antony, Jagadish, Alencier Ley Lopez, and Madhupal. Mammootty's upcoming projects include an action drama titled 'Om', releasing just weeks before 'Padayaatra'.

items.title: ‘Glee’ OTT reboot confirmed with original cast members reprising their roles
items.body: <![CDATA[The beloved musical series 'Glee' is making a comeback, with original cast members set to reprise their roles. Ryan Murphy expressed his excitement and nostalgia as he works on the new script, aiming to capture the show's magic once again. Heather Morris and Chord Overstreet have eagerly shared their return on social media, while Lea Michele is also confirmed to join, though she's yet to make an official announcement.

items.title: 'The Paradise' to 'Dorothy': South OTT releases this week
items.body: <![CDATA[Several South Indian films are set to stream on various platforms, including Netflix and ZEE5. 'Dhoomakethu' explores a wedding trapped in a time loop, while 'Dorothy' addresses themes of identity and family rejection. 'The Paradise' features an action-packed narrative led by Nani, focusing on the marginalized Savaari community's struggle. Additionally, 'Aasha' is a thriller centered on a woman's life disrupted by a road accident.

items.title: Matthew Perry’s sister reveals which ‘Friends’ scene was the most heartbreaking
items.body: <![CDATA[Mia Perry Bowick expressed that the wedding scene featuring her brother Matthew Perry's character in 'Friends' carried significant emotional weight. Filming coincided with Matthew's recent recovery from rehab, sparking concerns within the family about his future and relationships. Matthew has openly addressed his battles with addiction. A revealing documentary about his life, highlighting these issues, is set to debut on Netflix shortly.

items.title: 'Prahaar - The Ujjwal Nikam Story' day 6: Rajkummar Rao's film earns Rs 21.40 cr worldwide
items.body: <![CDATA[Prahaar - The Ujjwal Nikam Story collected Rs 1.50 crore on its sixth day, showing a notable drop. The film's total India net collection reached Rs 15.95 crore after six days in theaters. Rajkummar Rao portrayed public prosecutor Ujjwal Nikam, focusing on high-profile criminal cases in India. Its opening day earnings were Rs 2.35 crore, increasing over the weekend before declining mid-week.

items.title: Tiger firing case: Accused allegedly conducted recce of Ranbir's Bandra home
items.body: <![CDATA[Mumbai Police are currently probing a conspiracy potentially involving Bollywood celebrities like Tiger Shroff and Ranbir Kapoor. Investigators have traced the movements of suspects associated with the Lawrence Bishnoi gang after a firing incident. Initially targeted was Salman Khan, but investigators believe plans shifted towards Shroff. Three key accused have been remanded to police custody for further interrogation. Additional suspects were apprehended in Haryana and Uttar Pradesh during simultaneous raids.

items.title: Mouli’s ‘Donga Naa Koduku’ teaser shows how greed lands him in trouble
items.body: <![CDATA[In the upcoming comedy 'Donga Naa Koduku,' Mouli embodies Eeswar, a slothful and avaricious youth grappling with family tensions. The teaser portrays his father, played by comedian Ali, who is equally frustrated with Eeswar's antics. As Eeswar's ambition for wealth leads him into a series of chaotic heist escapades, the film promises to deliver laughter with unexpected outcomes. 'Donga Naa Koduku' is set to hit theaters on November 13, 2026.

items.title: ‘Doomsday’ gets IMAX release in China; ‘Dune 3’ POSTPONED
items.body: <![CDATA[‘Avengers: Doomsday’ is set to release in China on December 16, ahead of its US debut. The film will enjoy a two-week IMAX exclusive window due to a lack of competition. Meanwhile, ‘Dune: Part Three’ is scheduled to open in China on December 31, which may affect its box office performance. The Marvel film is targeting over USD 300 million at the Chinese box office.

items.title: 'People showed some ring that was on her hands': Vijay Deverakonda
items.body: <![CDATA[Vijay Deverakonda recently addressed rumors regarding an engagement ring worn by Rashmika Mandanna during a film shoot. He expressed frustration over assumptions made about the ring before their wedding and shared his actual gifts. The couple discussed their journey to marriage, highlighting Vijay's initial hesitation to commit. Rashmika maintained her desire for marriage and asked daily for a year before his proposal.

items.title: Woman who revived boyfriend twice after lightning strike to get bravery award

Stranded in an isolated area, they faced delays as rescuers searched for them without precise location data. After their recovery, Nick's heartfelt proposal led to their wedding nearly a year later in August. Eva's heroic actions highlight the life-saving potential of CPR knowledge in unpredictable outdoor situations.

items.title: Australian MP Helen Haines has both legs amputated after car attack
items.body: Helen Haines, an Australian federal lawmaker, is in critical condition following a violent car incident. Both of her legs were amputated due to severe injuries sustained during the attack. The accused driver, Brendan Nugent, has been charged but has not yet entered a plea. This incident has raised concerns about the safety of elected officials in Australia, prompting discussions on security measures.

items.title: Man repeatedly sent unsuitable matrimony profiles; commission orders Rs 37,000 relief

They highlighted the importance of matrimonial agencies transparently detailing their services to prevent consumer deception.

items.body: Ishan Kishan is gearing up for an exciting five-match T20I series against New Zealand, where he stands merely seven runs shy of breaking Suryakumar Yadav's impressive record for the most T20I runs within a year. With additional matches against Sri Lanka looming ahead, Kishan is poised to chase more milestones, aiming to become the first Indian cricketer to amass 2,000 T20 runs in a single calendar year.

items.title: Missouri court dismisses widow's appeal in $220,000 trust row as too late
items.body: Diane Longsdon encounters a significant legal hurdle as an appeals court dismisses her bid to contest a $220,000 repayment order. The issue originated from modifications to a family trust created by Violet M. Steinert and her spouse in 1994. Although Longsdon initially received money from these alterations, a court later upheld the original trust's validity.

items.title: US government fines Instacart $5 million over hiring practices
items.body: Instacart has been fined $5 million for allegedly discriminating against US-born workers in its hiring practices. The justice department accused Instacart of creating burdens for U.S. applicants during the Permanent Labor Certification process. A settlement has been reached, requiring Instacart to establish a fund for affected applicants and pay civil penalties. The company must also revise its employment policies and train staff on anti-discrimination laws.

Renowned for her performances in 'Darlings' and 'Jalsa', she had an eclectic career that included stints in radio and digital marketing until 2018, when she fully committed to acting. items.title: Ava Marie Saint’s cause of death confirmed
items.body: <![CDATA[Ava Marie Saint, the Oscar-winning actress, passed away on October 6 at the age of 102. She died from cardiopulmonary arrest, with contributing factors including senile dementia and hypertension. Saint was known for her roles in classics like 'On the Waterfront' and 'North by Northwest.' She is survived by two children, four grandchildren, and two great-grandchildren.

items.title: Watch: UP MLA Raja Bhaiyya worships 500+ guns on Dusshera
items.body: Raja Bhaiya conducted a Shastra Puja ceremony at his Benti Palace, displaying more than 500 weapons. His twin sons participated alongside block chiefs and hundreds of supporters carrying licensed weapons. This tradition has been observed since ancient times, emphasizing India's cultural heritage. Controversy arose earlier regarding alleged illegal weapons, which Raja Bhaiya's aide denied. Both sons have become increasingly involved in political activities since joining the Jansatta Dal (Loktantrik).

items.title: 65-year old swimmer killed in shark attack off South African coast; 2 beaches shut
items.body: Tragedy struck at Orient Beach in KuGompo City when 65-year-old open-water swimmer Janine Lochrenberg was fatally attacked by a shark. Despite the desperate efforts of fellow swimmers who rushed to assist her, she suffered life-threatening injuries to her arm and thigh, ultimately succumbing to her wounds. In response, local authorities promptly closed the beach and launched an investigation, as reports indicate a slight rise in shark attacks in recent years.

items.title: Why India slipped in Asian Games standings despite 24 medals as China extend lead
items.body: India achieved 24 medals, achieving five golds on Day 2 of the Asian Para Games 2026. Nishad Kumar and Deepthi Jeevanji led the country with outstanding athletic performances, contributing significantly to the medal tally. Despite this notable success, India's ranking dropped from fourth to sixth due to the gold medal count. China continued to lead the standings with a significant gap over competing nations.

items.title: Kerala man gets Rs 54,500 payout after cruise cancelled without notice
items.body: A family's dream cruise was abruptly canceled without warning, leaving them in distress. The District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission in Kerala found both the holiday company and cruise operator at fault. Despite repeated attempts to secure a refund after the cancellation, the complainant was denied compensation. The commission mandated a refund along with additional compensation for the trouble caused, allowing one month for compliance before penalties escalate.

items.title: Mark Cuban set up a ‘chain letter’ to pay college fees; he admits it was Ponzi scheme
items.body: Mark Cuban's inventive approach to funding his college education in the 1980s involved a unique dorm room chain letter that mimicked a Ponzi scheme. He sought financial support from other students, redistributing a portion of the money to prior contributors. Cuban’s entrepreneurial journey began with selling trash bags to neighbors. After graduating, he moved to Dallas, immersing himself in tech skills while balancing work commitments.

items.title: Barbara Hutton's Rolls-Royce survived prince's fatal crash, sold for £166,750
items.body: This remarkable 1933 Rolls-Royce Phantom II Continental was originally crafted as a luxurious present from Barbara Hutton to Prince Alexis Mdivani. Following a tragic accident that claimed the prince's life, the exquisite vehicle was returned to Hutton for repairs. It changed hands multiple times before making its way to the United States in the 1970s.

items.title: Georgia court upholds verdict voiding stepson's home deed, $57,600 award
items.body: In a complex property dispute, a woman in Georgia transferred her property interest to her stepson during a period of cognitive decline. Her guardian, suspecting exploitation and fraud, pursued legal action, leading to a jury decision that invalidated the transfer and awarded damages. The stepson contested this ruling, alleging jury misconduct. However, the appeals court decided to uphold the initial verdict, solidifying the guardian's victory.

items.title: Florida couple missed 66 mortgage payments; man's bank lawsuit rejected
items.body: A Florida couple missed 66 monthly mortgage payments on their Naples property, triggering a foreclosure dispute that began in 2009. During the legal battle, Gregory Brian Myers agreed to deposit $5,000 monthly while appealing the foreclosure. He later sued U.S. Bank, alleging it had violated their agreement. On October 19, 2026, a federal appeals court upheld the dismissal of his lawsuit.

items.title: 'Disregards consensus': China slams US for after DeepSeek ban from govt IT systems
items.body: China has strongly criticized the US for its recent ban on the DeepSeek AI model, claiming it undermines the interests of Chinese enterprises. The Chinese commerce ministry pointed out that the US Department of Homeland Security's concerns regarding security threats from DeepSeek products are unfounded. China warns against the politicization of technology and national security concerns, suggesting that this development could further strain economic relations between the two superpowers.
